ai_study_plan.strategy: This week is organized to build a balanced diagnostic foundation by addressing key skills in both Reading and Writing, and Math. The lighter Friday is reserved for review and reflection, while the heavier weekend days focus on targeted practice and error analysis. The plan prioritizes skills with the highest potential impact on score improvement.

days.rationale: Command of Evidence is a critical skill for Reading and Writing, and early focus ensures foundational understanding before moving to more complex tasks.
days.completion_check: Complete 27 questions in a Reading and Writing module with 32 minutes, then review all errors.

blocks.title: Reading and Writing Module: Command of Evidence (Textual)
blocks.description: Take a full Reading and Writing module focusing on Command of Evidence (Textual) questions. Use the 32-minute time limit and answer all 27 questions. After the module, review all errors and analyze the cause.

blocks.title: Review Command of Evidence (Textual) Errors
blocks.description: Review all errors from the module, identify the cause (e.g., misreading, poor inference, or lack of evidence), and note patterns for future focus.

days.task: Linear Equations in Two Variables Practice
days.rationale: Linear equations in two variables are a core math skill that often appears in multiple question types, and early focus ensures mastery before more complex topics.
days.completion_check: Complete 22 questions in a Math module with 35 minutes, then review all errors.

blocks.title: Review Linear Equations in Two Variables Errors
